metadata.description: Red tiles form an eight-point geometric rosette inspired by Ukrainian embroidery. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Diagonal stepping fields surround the motif, with broken crescents along the lower route. 5 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
